criteriaNotes.0_hash_check: pixel_sha256 computed with src/harnesses/_core/object_gate on both 32x32 PNGs at review time; hashes recorded per item below. Closed/open differ only inside bbox x4..27,y5..27 (510 px); kerb frame and the 1px transparent margin are identical in both states (154 transparent px each).
criteriaNotes.1_topdown_view: Both are flush floor pieces seen from above: kerb top plane with a lit top row (b9ab9d) and a dark south lip (3a3530/645c54). The closed lid is a flat plane with a 1-row dark front lip at the bottom (y26-27), and the star groove is lit from the upper left, which is consistent. Open: the steps descend north, each step drawn as top plane plus darker riser, darkening and narrowing toward the north wall as in v5 stairs down. No side or iso faces.
criteriaNotes.2_style_fit: Kerb uses a 4-step warm-grey ramp (3a3530/645c54/8e8378/b9ab9d) with sparse speckle, which matches v5 stone texture density. The lid's black (131317/1e1e24/2a2a32/41414c), purple sigil (violet rune dots, star core) and gold match the seal-stone steles' material. The open steps are the v5 stairs-down construction recoloured into the kerb ramp, with near-black (08080a/131317) depth at the top. Closed has 16 colours and open has 9; no stray hues.
criteriaNotes.3_readability_1x: At 1x in the archive mockup the closed piece reads immediately as a sealed stone hatch with a gold/purple star. The open piece reads unambiguously as stairs going down: pale near steps, dark void at the top.
criteriaNotes.4_placement: Sits between the two seal-stone steles, centred, with clear wood floor around it. The kerb's warm grey separates it from the wood planks without glowing, and the purple/gold ties it visually to the flanking steles. It does not stand out against the existing v5 art in either state.
criteriaNotes.5_silhouette_outline: Clean rectangular outline (3a3530) with a full 1px border; no jaggies, orphan pixels or AA fuzz. One cosmetic nit: the lower-right inner corner has a lone near-black pixel at (27,27) in the closed state and (27,26) in the open state. It sits below or inside the opening's bottom edge and breaks left/right symmetry with x=4. It is invisible at 1x, so it is not blocking.

items.name: 별 봉인 돌뚜껑(닫힘, 2×2) (star seal)
items.reasons: Reads as a black stone lid set flush in a warm stone kerb, with a carved five-point star (gold rim, purple core with a light centre) and an octagonal rune-dot ring. The material matches the seal-stone steles exactly. The lid's front lip gives the correct 3/4 depth for a flush-set slab. Shading of the star groove (pale gold on the upper-left facets, deeper gold lower right) is consistent with top-left light. Optional polish: make (27,27) 3a3530 to match (4,27) so the lip ends square.

items.name: 별 봉인 돌계단(열림, 2×2) (star seal open)
items.reasons: Kerb frame is pixel-identical to the closed state, so the swap is seamless. Stone steps follow v5 stairs-down construction: tread top plane plus darker riser, narrowing and darkening northward into a near-black void, side walls in shadow. Reads as stairs going down at 1x. Optional polish: (27,26) is 08080a while the mirrored (4,26) is 131317; make it 131317 for symmetry.
